title: South Carolina's measles outbreak jumped to Washington state 5 times in 2 weeks
summary: International travel used to be the main risk of measles cases in the US—not anymore.
llm_summary: A recent measles flare‑up that began in South Carolina has already seeded five new cases in Washington state within just two weeks, illustrating how quickly the disease can hop across the country. While international travel used to be the primary way measles entered the U.S., today domestic movement—especially long‑distance trips and gatherings—has become the main driver
